content:
The HWPX transformation successfully processed fragmented placeholders, phase duration calculations, and budget normalization while ensuring layout integrity.
A tag-stripping regex resolved placeholders split across multiple <hp:t> tags, and post-processing verified no '{{...}}' patterns remained. Phase lines (e.g., 단계1) were updated with computed month spans by appending to the final <hp:t> child within the parent <hp:p> block. Budget strings were normalized by removing commas while preserving '₩' symbols. Layout corruption was prevented by removing <hp:lineSegArray> elements to force HWP renderer recalculation.
